gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Dusty-bookshelf charm leads, with Mystery Quest opening every curve wide and tucking its ascenders low above tall lowercase. Mystery Quest does flourish best; Noto Sans Tagalog keeps the middle-heavy lines tidy.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look, with ascenders kept compact. But Noto Sans Tagbanwa is the sans-serif that handles clarity, its lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le lets its strokes taper out before they touch, with hardly any step up to capitals. Noto Sans Tai Le is approachable enough to let Mystery Quest play the bookish, nostalgic show-off.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Bookish open-jawed curves meet chalkboard-tall lowercase, with Noto Sans Tai Tham crowding the capital line under Mystery Quest. Mystery Quest earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Nostalgic bookshelf charm, with Mystery Quest curving open-jawed above the short ascenders of Noto Sans Tai Viet. And Noto Sans Tai Viet takes a slightly generous size well, its tall x-height holding up.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-takri: Open jaws on every curve define Mystery Quest, a bookish display face with compact ascenders. And Noto Sans Takri, with its unclosed small rounds and high-waisted lowercase, looks best given a little extra size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil is a sans-serif that looks magnified even at ordinary size, its terminals stopping far from the stem. Mystery Quest brings a bookish, nostalgic note on top.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Nostalgic from the first glance, thanks to Mystery Quest and its open-jawed curves. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, a sans with round forms like open parentheses, gives that display voice a stocky, tall-bodied line to sit against.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Curved strokes that gape open on every letter give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic pull, with ascenders held compact. Noto Sans Tangsa, a sans with inviting round openings, is the approachable counterweight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tc: Compact ascenders above tall lowercase are the signature of Mystery Quest, a nostalgic display face with a bookish streak. Noto Sans TC, a sans-serif with outward-opening curves, gives that character a roomy, approachable partner on the page.
